title: Dasatinib Plus Anti-CD19/CD22 Bispecific CAR-T Cell Therapy for Elderly Ph-positive ALL Patients

sections.abstract: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of Dasatinib plus CD19/CD22 Bispecific CAR-T for the treatment of elderly Ph-positive lymphoblastic leukemia. Newly diagnosed Ph-positive patients will be given Dasatinib plus VP chemotherapy for induction treatment,if a hematologic complete remission was observed then a lymphocyte collection will be administrated to patients.
